notes: Stagger schedules avoid Render hot-spots at :00. Heavy endpoints (Stripe, DeepSeek) throttled. Light endpoints pings Render so it never idle-spins. The Nova static monitor (every 10 min, onFailure email alert) is the free uptime smoke test for the deployed frontend.

jobs.name: Warm-up Ping A
jobs.purpose: Prevents Render free-tier spin-down after 15 min idle.

jobs.name: Warm-up Ping B
jobs.purpose: Interleaves with Ping A so Render is touched every ~10 min.

jobs.name: Simulated Traffic Beacon
jobs.purpose: Keeps analytics dashboard populated with steady traffic.

jobs.name: Daily Lead Capture
jobs.purpose: Two scheduled passive signups per day grow the lead list.

jobs.name: Content Syndication Push
jobs.purpose: Pumps blog posts to Medium/Dev.to on a 4-hour cadence.

jobs.name: DeepSeek Blog Generator
jobs.purpose: Publishes a fresh SEO article every 6 hours via DeepSeek.

jobs.name: Revenue: Trigger Affiliate Vertical
jobs.purpose: Fires the affiliate agent swarm twice daily (afternoon + late night).

jobs.name: Revenue: Trigger Bounty / Grants
jobs.purpose: Runs bounty & grant discovery twice daily (morning + evening).

jobs.name: Revenue: Kitchen-Sink Sprint
jobs.purpose: Heaviest endpoint — runs the full vertical stack twice daily (early AM + mid-afternoon).

jobs.name: Nova Production Smoke Monitor
jobs.purpose: Free uptime smoke test for the deployed Nova static UI. GETs the live site every 10 min (staggered, never on :00); setup.py enables onFailure email alerts so a non-200 page notifies you immediately.

jobs.name: Render Backend Health Monitor
jobs.purpose: Free uptime monitor for the Go backend (expects {"status":"ok"}). GETs /health every 10 min, offset from the Nova monitor so UI + API are checked every 5 min combined; onFailure email alert catches cold-start failures or an unhealthy backend. Also acts as an extra keep-alive between the warm-up pings.
